answer_1.quote: To evaluate end-to-end performance on downstream tasks, we measured exact match (EM) and F1 score by comparing the predicted and gold short answers for OTT-QA and 2WikiMultiHop. For Bird, execution accuracy was defined as 1 if the predicted and gold SQL statements produced the same execution results and 0 otherwise.
